note: I4 fact gold. Authored BEFORE extraction from the frozen capability matrix (capability_matrix.json sha d0b77c03…). Three classes: A SUPPORTED_POSITIVE (inside the executable envelope — counts toward recall), B OUT_OF_ENVELOPE (semantically valid but outside frozen capability — correct behavior is abstention, NOT a false negative), C MUST_NOT_ASSERT (any positive fact is a HARD failure).

supported_positive.note: subject/object types verified against the frozen signatures; trigger verified against verbs/nouns/multiword; frame = SUBJ_BEFORE_TRIGGER_OBJ_AFTER (default) or ARG1_AFTER_ARG2_AFTER_PREP (association).
